arguments.name: Sana
arguments.phone: nine eight six Seven six five. One three five seven nine

message: 'nine eight six Seven six five. One three five seven nine' is not a 10-digit phone number.
reply: That number didn’t come through as a valid 10-digit phone number. Could you please say all ten digits again?
reason: It explained that the number was invalid and asked the caller to repeat all ten digits.
